clue.text: Language of offensive old books rejected

parts.note: an offensive is a military push

indicators.note: rejected means the abbreviation is thrown back, read right to left

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, the old books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A scholar dismisses the old books written in a crude, offensive tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns OT into TO. Pushto (Pashto) is the language of the Pashtuns of Afghanistan and Pakistan.
explanation.definitionFit: Pushto is a variant spelling of Pashto, an Iranian tongue spoken in Afghanistan.

clue.text: Strain on part of the body leading to retreat

parts.note: to pull is to strain or tug
the back is a part of the body

explanation.surface: A strained muscle in the back forces a withdrawal from competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A pullback is a withdrawal of troops, a retreat from a position.

clue.text: Flag and little flower given to Queen

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river, and a little one is a stream
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A banner and a small bloom are presented to Her Majesty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is read as flow-er, a thing that flows, so a small river.
explanation.definitionFit: A streamer is a long narrow flag or pennant.

clue.text: Bit of joint in which musical group's turned up

indicators.note: turned up means read upwards, reversing the word in a down entry

parts.note: a nonet is a group of nine musicians

explanation.surface: A band turns up at the bar where the joint is jumping.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenon is the projecting tongue of a woodworking joint, fitted into a mortise.

clue.text: Something with a blade kills woman

parts.note: to ice someone is slang for to murder them
Kate is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A bladed weapon is the means by which a woman meets her end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Something with a blade' suggests a knife or sword; the blade is the runner beneath a skating boot.
explanation.definitionFit: An ice skate is a boot fitted with a metal blade for gliding on frozen surfaces.

clue.text: Like a monk given vocation and told to keep quiet at start of meeting?

definitions.meaning: summoned by God to join a religious community

definitions.text: told to keep quiet at start of meeting
definitions.meaning: a chair opens a meeting by calling for silence and attention

explanation.definitionFit: A monk is summoned into a religious brotherhood, and a meeting is opened with a call for silence.

clue.text: Extraordinarily wonderful guy who could make hope surer

indicators.note: could make means these letters can be made into something else, rearranged

explanation.surface: A marvellous chap who could make our hopes more certain.
explanation.definitionFit: A superhero is a comic-book figure with extraordinary powers, a marvellously admirable man.

clue.text: Survey oxygen after a space mission

indicators.note: after places the survey and oxygen behind the a

parts.note: a poll is a survey of opinion
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A poll is taken on oxygen supply following a space mission.
explanation.definitionFit: Apollo was the NASA programme of space flights that put astronauts on the Moon.

clue.text: Wings, see, with skill ascending

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city and bishop's see in Cambridgeshire

indicators.note: ascending means going upwards, reading backwards in a down clue

parts.note: art means skill

explanation.surface: Look at the wings, flown skilfully upwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' is a bishop's diocese here, not look; ELY is the stock example.
explanation.definitionFit: Elytra are the hardened forewings of beetles that cover the flying wings.

clue.text: Taylor enjoys entertaining another actress

indicators.note: entertaining means holding within, so the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Elizabeth Taylor likes having a fellow film star over as a guest.
explanation.walkthrough: The run spans the end of Taylor and the start of enjoys. 'another' links the definition to Taylor in the surface: Sophia Loren is another actress.
explanation.definitionFit: Sophia Loren is a celebrated Italian film star, so she is one example of an actress.

clue.text: Music institution once fraudulent

parts.note: a poly was a polytechnic, a British college type abolished as a category in 1992
phony means fake or fraudulent

explanation.surface: A music college of former times was exposed as a sham.
explanation.walkthrough: Polytechnics were British higher-education colleges that became universities in 1992, hence 'once'.
explanation.definitionFit: Polyphony is music woven from several independent melodic lines sounding together.

clue.text: Sincere chap spouting (primarily real Luddite within?)

definitions.text: Sincere chap spouting (primarily real Luddite within?)

indicators.note: spouting means holding forth, the letters gushing out in a new order
primarily means taking the first letters of the following words

explanation.surface: An earnest fellow sounds off, perhaps a real opponent of modern technology at heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spouting' scrambles the fodder and 'primarily' takes the heads of real and Luddite. The then Prince of Wales was known for distrusting modern things, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The then Prince of Wales was famous for criticising modern architecture and technology, so he was seen as one resisting progress.

clue.text: Ena is bare, cavorting? That's saucy

indicators.note: cavorting means prancing about, so the letters jump into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman called Ena frolics naked, which is rather risque.
explanation.walkthrough: 'saucy' looks like cheeky, but here it means being a sauce: béarnaise is a classic French sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Béarnaise is a rich butter and egg-yolk sauce flavoured with tarragon, so it is literally a sauce-like thing.

clue.text: The head may be wooden in school

definitions.meaning: the head of a state or organisation is the person in charge, a monarch or sovereign
a measuring stick for drawing lines, often made of wood, used by schoolchildren

explanation.definitionFit: A sovereign is one who rules, and a straight-edged measuring stick shares the same name.

clue.text: Wire in the mousetrap?

parts.note: mousetrap is slang for a block of plain cheddar, and the wire that slices a block of it is the tool meant

explanation.definitionFit: A wire with a handle used to slice blocks of hard cheese is called by this name.

clue.text: Store "black stuff", as you might say, in this bunker

indicators.note: as you might say means the words are spoken, sounding like the answer

parts.note: to stock coal is to store the black stuff, fuel for a furnace

explanation.surface: Keep the coal in this storage space.
explanation.definitionFit: A stokehole is the space in a ship where furnaces are stoked, alongside the coal bunkers.

clue.text: Rotten fellow ("Bad Bill") in car

parts.note: a cad is a rotten fellow, a bounder
ill means bad, as in ill will
AC is short for account, a bill

explanation.surface: A villain nicknamed Bad Bill sits in his motor.
explanation.definitionFit: A Cadillac is a large American luxury car.

clue.text: "Banish lessons about many faiths" — Pope's man?

parts.note: RE is religious education, school lessons about the world's religions
a legate is a papal envoy, the Pope's representative

explanation.surface: A papal envoy demands that teaching about other religions be banned.
explanation.definitionFit: To relegate is to banish or consign someone to a lower place.

clue.text: Drink gives one dreadful toothache, pressure region being squeezed

indicators.note: being squeezed means pressed inside the other letters
dreadful signals the letters are in a terrible state and must be rearranged

parts.note: a col is a region of low pressure between two anticyclones on a weather map

explanation.surface: A sugary drink can leave you with terrible toothache.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' scrambles the tooth complaint and 'being squeezed' presses the weather term inside it. 'gives one' is a link: the drink gives a person toothache.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot chocolate is a warm beverage made from cocoa and milk.

clue.text: Item left in car

indicators.note: in means the letter for left goes inside the word for car

parts.note: a coupé is a two-door car

explanation.surface: An object has been left behind in the car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Item' is the informal sense: two people in a relationship.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people romantically involved are called an item, a couple.

clue.text: Excellent hint to big boozers half ignored

parts.note: a tip is a hint

indicators.note: half ignored means the second half of the word is disregarded

parts.note: topers are heavy drinkers

explanation.surface: Advice for heavy drinkers to cut their intake by half is first rate.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiptop is an informal word meaning of the highest quality.

clue.text: Girl with whom there's nothing "switched on"

parts.note: O is zero, nothing
a live wire or circuit is switched on and carrying current

explanation.surface: A girl with no electricity in her life, nothing switched on.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive is a female given name, so it can stand for a girl.

clue.text: Extra cocaine is brought in — it being this?

definitions.text: Extra cocaine is brought in — it being this?

indicators.note: is brought in means the drug letter is put inside the word for extra

parts.note: an additive is an extra ingredient put into something
C is the street abbreviation for cocaine

explanation.surface: More of the drug is smuggled in, because it is so habit-forming.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: cocaine is brought in again and again because it is habit-forming.
explanation.definitionFit: Something habit-forming, like cocaine, keeps users coming back for more of it.

clue.text: Person underground, given warning, runs

parts.note: cave, Latin for beware, was the schoolboy's warning cry
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A man in hiding is tipped off and flees.
explanation.walkthrough: CAVE (said 'kay-vee') was a British schoolboy lookout's call that a teacher was coming.
explanation.definitionFit: A caver explores caves, so is a person who goes underground.

clue.text: Work created for a return — book penned by drudge?

definitions.text: Work created for a return — book penned by drudge?

indicators.note: for a return means the short word for work is turned round

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: penned by means enclosed within, as in a pen

parts.note: a toiler is one who does hard, tedious work

explanation.surface: A hack grinds out a book just to earn some money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a return' turns the short word for a work round, and 'penned by' encloses the book letter. The whole clue also defines: a hack's book written only to make money.
explanation.definitionFit: A potboiler is a book written quickly simply to earn money, keeping the pot on the boil.

clue.text: Physicist as radical writer releasing anger

indicators.note: releasing means letting go of part of the name, so it is removed

parts.note: Voltaire was the radical French Enlightenment writer
ire means anger

explanation.surface: A physicist is cast as a radical author who lets go of rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'releasing' drops IRE from VOLTAIRE to leave Alessandro Volta.
explanation.definitionFit: Alessandro Volta was the Italian scientist who invented the battery and gave his name to the volt.

clue.text: Convey love, offering coffee

parts.note: to express a feeling is to convey it
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: Show your affection by offering someone a coffee.
explanation.walkthrough: Expresso is an accepted variant spelling of espresso.
explanation.definitionFit: Expresso is a variant spelling of espresso, strong black coffee made under pressure.

clue.text: Welsh craft won't allow leader to show authority

indicators.note: won't allow leader to show means the first letter is kept out of sight

parts.note: a coracle is a small round boat traditional in Wales

explanation.surface: A small Welsh boat won't let its captain display his command.
explanation.walkthrough: 'won't allow leader to show' removes the C at the head of CORACLE.
explanation.definitionFit: An oracle is a person or source consulted as an infallible authority on some subject.
